notes: «هو أخو حماد بن زيد» after سعيد بن زيد is the compiler's gloss: left out.
«فذكر نحوه» means the matn is elided; the chain as written ends at أبي لبيد, and the Companion is not written in this report.
«وأبو لبيد اسمه لمازة بن زبار» is the compiler's comment after the matn, not part of the chain; not used.
